steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Set up app package name com.smartocrscanner.app and application identity for Mobile Shop Stock Management.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest & Activities
steps.description: Register Stock Management activities, camera permissions, and FileProvider in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Update Application Colors & Strings
steps.description: Define strings and color schemes for Mobile Shop Inventory, Stock In/Out, and OCR parsing.

steps.title: Create Mobile Inventory Data Models
steps.description: Implement MobileModel and InventoryLogModel Java classes for shop stock management.

steps.title: Implement Mobile OCR Text Parser
steps.description: Create MobileOcrParser to automatically extract Brand, Model, IMEI 1/2, Serial, RAM, Storage, and Color from text.

steps.title: Upgrade SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Upgrade ScanHistoryDbHelper with mobiles and inventory_logs tables while preserving existing scan data.

steps.title: Design Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Redesign activity_main.xml to display total stock, stock in/out summary, quick actions, and recent mobile entries.

steps.title: Design Mobile Form & Stock Screen Layouts
steps.description: Create layout files for mobile addition/editing, Stock In, Stock Out, inventory listing, and activity history.

steps.title: Implement Add/Edit Mobile Form Logic
steps.description: Code AddEditMobileActivity for OCR camera/gallery pre-fill and manual mobile entry with duplicate IMEI validation.

steps.title: Implement Stock In Activity Logic
steps.description: Code StockInActivity for viewing incoming inventory, camera/gallery OCR stock intake, edit, and delete functions.

steps.title: Implement Stock Out Activity Logic
steps.description: Code StockOutActivity to search inventory by IMEI/Serial/Model, record customer sales details, and mark devices as SOLD.

steps.title: Implement All Mobiles Inventory Listing
steps.description: Code AllMobilesActivity with live search, brand filters, status filters (Available/Sold), and item operations.

steps.title: Implement Stock Audit History Activity
steps.description: Code HistoryActivity for reviewing Stock In, Stock Out, edits, and deletions with timestamped logs.

steps.title: Update Main Dashboard & OCR Result Activities
steps.description: Integrate ML Kit text recognition with mobile auto-parser in MainActivity and ResultActivity.

steps.title: Building Smart OCR Scanner
steps.description: Compile final APK package and verify offline Mobile Shop Stock Management execution.
